actions.archive_emails.description: Moves emails to the Archive folder.

actions.create_draft.description: Saves a new draft email in the Drafts folder.

actions.create_folder.description: Creates a folder, optionally inside a parent folder.

actions.create_folder.props.parent_folde: Optional existing folder path from list_folders to create the folder inside.

actions.get_quota.description: Gets the storage and message quota for a folder.

actions.list_folders.props.include_count: Also return the total and unread message count of each folder. Slower on accounts with many folders.

actions.search_emails.props.flagged.desc: Filter by the flagged (starred) state. Leave empty for both.
actions.search_emails.props.from.descrip: Text contained in the From header.
actions.search_emails.props.keyword.desc: Only messages carrying this custom keyword (IMAP flag).
actions.search_emails.props.limit.descri: Maximum number of emails to return (1-100).
actions.search_emails.props.message_id.d: Exact Message-ID header value, for example <abc@example.com>.

actions.search_emails.props.text.descrip: Text contained anywhere in the headers or body.
actions.search_emails.props.to.descripti: Text contained in the To header.

auth.description:
Enter your email provider's IMAP settings. Their help pages list them.

**Gmail**
1. Turn on IMAP in [Gmail settings](https://support.google.com/mail/answer/7126229?hl=en).
2. Create an [App Password](https://support.google.com/accounts/answer/185833?hl=en) and use it as the password.
3. Use host `imap.gmail.com`, port `993`, and turn on **Use TLS**.
auth.props.password.description: Your email password, or an App Password for Gmail.
auth.props.port.description: Usually 993 with TLS on, or 143 with TLS off.
auth.props.tls.description: Turn on for port 993. Most providers require it.
auth.props.validateCertificates.descript: Reject servers whose certificate is invalid or self-signed.
description: Watch for new emails and copy, move, mark or delete them over IMAP.
triggers.new_email.description: Starts the flow when a new email arrives in a folder.
triggers.new_email.props.filterInstructi: New emails in this folder start the flow, in the order they arrived. To act on only some, add a **Router** step after this trigger.
triggers.new_email.props.mailbox.descrip: Folder to watch for new emails.
